description: This file defines an interface class IIpcFactory for creating IPC server components related to application management, session management, and control services within the Rialto media server project. It includes method declarations for factory methods that produce unique pointers to server interface objects, and references several other interface headers.

classes.name: IIpcFactory
classes.description: An interface class providing factory methods to create various IPC server components for the Rialto media server.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IApplicationManagementServer, given a session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISessionManagementServer, given playback, cdm, and control services.
